text: Réunion, officially the Department of Réunion, is an overseas department and region of France, east of Madagascar in the Indian Ocean. As such, for country streaks purposes, it is **counted as France**.
text_zh: 留尼旺官方名稱為留尼旺省，是法國的海外省與海外大區，位於印度洋馬達加斯加以東。因此，在進行國家連勝（country streaks）挑戰時，它**被視為法國**。

text: Réunion has a Street View car with visible side mirrors, a roof rack, and **black tape** at the end of the **rear right bar**.
NOTE: Make sure not to get this confused with the Ghana car, which has tape on the front right bar.
text_zh: 留尼旺的 Google 車具有清晰可見的車外後視鏡、車頂架，且**右後桿**的末端貼有**黑色膠帶**。
注意：請確保不要將其與迦納的 Google 車搞混，迦納的車是在前右桿上貼有膠帶。

text: Being a French Department, you will see **French infrastructure**, such as [signs](https://goo.gl/maps/g4Zs8JkqkiWbQYt28), [bollards](https://www.google.com/maps/@-21.2427103,55.3131219,3a,75y,99.88h,80.84t,358.51r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sfAEf2UYNe56no-OLI1RWoA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) and [poles](https://www.google.com/maps/@-21.281482,55.4317286,3a,90y,19.99h,96.64t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sm6b5qi8oScL85YCcGo5E_g!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu).
text_zh: 身為法國的省份，你會看到**法國的基礎設施**，例如[標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/g4Zs8JkqkiWbQYt28)、[路樁](https://www.google.com/maps/@-21.2427103,55.3131219,3a,75y,99.88h,80.84t,358.51r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sfAEf2UYNe56no-OLI1RWoA!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)與[電線桿](https://www.google.com/maps/@-21.281482,55.4317286,3a,90y,19.99h,96.64t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sm6b5qi8oScL85YCcGo5E_g!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)。

text: Réunion is a mountainous volcanic island in the Indian Ocean on a similar latitude to Queensland, Australia. Most roads are along the coast, with lush green mountains visible close by. Vegetation consists of [palms](https://goo.gl/maps/NjLXjEScWkmUzNQ17) and [ferns](https://goo.gl/maps/6oLGxZkvfaiTBqZg7), [pine trees](https://goo.gl/maps/J7vpe2wV2kptobfE9) at higher elevation, and [flowering plants](https://goo.gl/maps/zKst3y8NcdYipxtf6) due to the island’s tropical savanna climate.
text_zh: 留尼旺是印度洋上的多火山山岳島嶼，緯度與澳洲昆士蘭相近。大多數道路沿著海岸修建，附近可見蒼翠繁茂的綠色山脈。植被包含[棕櫚樹](https://goo.gl/maps/NjLXjEScWkmUzNQ17)、[蕨類](https://goo.gl/maps/6oLGxZkvfaiTBqZg7)、高海拔處的[松樹](https://goo.gl/maps/J7vpe2wV2kptobfE9)，以及因該島的熱帶莽原氣候而生的[開花植物](https://goo.gl/maps/zKst3y8NcdYipxtf6)。

sections.title: Regional and arrondissement-specific clues
sections.title_zh: 區域與行政區專屬線索

text: Only a handful of roads were covered without a trekker. Learning the general regions with coverage will help you get those extra 10 points.
text_zh: 只有少數道路沒有使用徒步拍攝覆蓋。了解有覆蓋的通用區域將有助於你獲得那額外 10 分。

text: There are six distinct bus stop designs on Réunion:

- [Yellow](https://goo.gl/maps/q9CtkypqeALhBfrC7) - This is the most common type and can be found all over the island. It is usually accompanied by another bus stop, meaning you can get a good region guess if you see it on its own.

- [L Shaped](https://goo.gl/maps/Yts9EDaePYnjKk1L8) - It can either be white, or an [olive](https://goo.gl/maps/jgR9cBEvaMmKFu8SA) colour. It may also be in the form of a [bus shelter](https://goo.gl/maps/ERRyoQBRSTDCwNPL6). It is almost never accompanied by a yellow bus stop.
- [Pink](https://goo.gl/maps/psuwbrTTAkRmBatTA) - Rarely accompanied by a yellow bus stop.
- [Orange](https://goo.gl/maps/iab3u7VkEDbP1hSb6) - Almost always accompanied by a yellow bus stop.
- [Green](https://goo.gl/maps/kg61UkiurFFoe8hX6) - Almost always accompanied by a yellow bus stop.
- [Red](https://goo.gl/maps/tL9qM1Uzg6ThwBay7) - Rarely accompanied by a yellow bus stop.
This infographic shows where each one can be found. The list above is ranked by how common each one is found.
_You can click on the image to enlarge it._
text_zh: 留尼旺有六種截然不同的公車站牌設計：
- [黃色](https://goo.gl/maps/q9CtkypqeALhBfrC7) - 這是最常見的類型，全島各地都找得到。它通常會伴隨另一個公車站牌出現，這意味著如果你單獨看到它，就能很好地猜出區域。
- [L 形](https://goo.gl/maps/Yts9EDaePYnjKk1L8) - 可以是白色，或是[橄欖綠](https://goo.gl/maps/jgR9cBEvaMmKFu8SA)。它也可能以[候車亭](https://goo.gl/maps/ERRyoQBRSTDCwNPL6)的形式出現。幾乎從不與黃色公車站牌同時出現。
- [粉紅色](https://goo.gl/maps/psuwbrTTAkRmBatTA) - 很少與黃色公車站牌同時出現。
- [橘色](https://goo.gl/maps/iab3u7VkEDbP1hSb6) - 幾乎總是與黃色公車站牌同時出現。
- [綠色](https://goo.gl/maps/kg61UkiurFFoe8hX6) - 幾乎總是與黃色公車站牌同時出現。
- [紅色](https://goo.gl/maps/tL9qM1Uzg6ThwBay7) - 很少與黃色公車站牌同時出現。
這張資訊圖表顯示了每種站牌的所在位置。上面的列表是依據各站牌的常見程度由高到低排列。
_點擊圖片可放大。_

text: **Sugarcane plantations** on Réunion can be found in two regions: the northeast and the southwest. The southwest is generally more built up and densely populated, meaning you will see more buildings or cars around.
text_zh: 留尼旺的**甘蔗種植園**分佈在兩個區域：東北部和西南部。西南部通常開發較完全且人口較稠密，這意味著你會看到周圍有較多建築物或車輛。

text: Cilaos is a town inside a **caldera**. It can be recognized by the **wall** of mountains surrounding the town with **overcast** coverage.
text_zh: 奇拉奧斯是**火山破火山口**內的一個城鎮。它的特徵是環繞城鎮、帶有**陰天**覆蓋的群山**牆壁**。

text: You can spot this **rectangular blur** on the front camera in all the coverage going north of Saint-Louis.
text_zh: 在聖路易以北的所有街景覆蓋中，你都可以在前置相機畫面中發現這種**矩形模糊**。

text: The northwestern section of the N1 is divided, with a **distinct ridge** to the southeast and the ocean to the northwest.
Note that although a bridge appears on the map, the coverage was taken before the bridge was built, meaning you will not see the bridge.
text_zh: N1 的西北路段為雙向分道，東南側有**明顯的山脊**，西北側則是海洋。
請注意，儘管地圖上顯示了一座橋梁，但街景拍攝時該橋梁尚未建造，這意味著你不會看到這座橋。

text: Route du Volcan can be recognized by the **Martian** landscape. The only vegetation is scattered shrubs and the soil is a distinct **brown-red** colour. These [white stones](https://goo.gl/maps/UFYFzYRav6h75Fge8) lining the road are also a good clue.
text_zh: 火山公路（Route du Volcan）可以從其**火星**般的景觀認出。唯一的植被是零星的灌木，土壤則是明顯的**紅褐色**。道路兩旁這些[白色石頭](https://goo.gl/maps/UFYFzYRav6h75Fge8)也是很好的線索。

text: La Route Forestière 58 de la Scierie et du Haut des Makes is a **winding dirt track** that can be recognized by the **dense vegetation** surrounding it, particularly pine trees and eucalyptus. The track itself is also dark in colour, with grass growing in the middle of it.
text_zh: 58 號鋸木廠與上馬克斯森林公路（La Route Forestière 58 de la Scierie et du Haut des Makes）是一條**蜿蜒的泥土路**，其特徵是周圍環繞著**濃密的植被**，特別是松樹和尤加利樹。路面本身顏色偏暗，中間長著草。

text: The eastern region of Réunion is the least densely populated, evident by the eastern part of the N2, which is a single carriageway passing through [somewhat dense vegetation on both sides](https://goo.gl/maps/1vJBXBfvwwi8YyB37), or a [vast landscape](https://goo.gl/maps/dCWLTzJzexxtujih9) with little to no trees.
text_zh: 留尼旺東部地區人口最稀少，N2 的東部路段即是明證：這是一條單車道公路，穿過[兩側相當茂密的植被](https://goo.gl/maps/1vJBXBfvwwi8YyB37)，或是幾乎沒有樹木的[廣闊景觀](https://goo.gl/maps/dCWLTzJzexxtujih9)。

text: The two largest towns in Réunion can be differentiated by their **bollards**, commonly seen at intersections. Saint Paul uses [black](https://goo.gl/maps/BCFWSpgwGXQNRTZG7) bollards, while Saint Denis uses [green](https://goo.gl/maps/zKaQEWScWPr9oF4z5) bollards, often with white balls on top. Saint Denis is also more built up, being the capital.
text_zh: 留尼旺最大的兩個城鎮可以透過通常出現在路口的**路樁**來區分。聖保羅使用[黑色](https://goo.gl/maps/BCFWSpgwGXQNRTZG7)路樁，而聖丹尼使用[綠色](https://goo.gl/maps/zKaQEWScWPr9oF4z5)路樁，頂部通常有白色圓球。聖丹尼身為首都，開發也較為完善。
